Copper is the CRM built exclusively for Google Workspace, making it a standout choice for teams that live in Gmail, Calendar, and Drive. It has a 4.5/5 rating from 1,100+ verified G2 reviews and is used by 30,000+ businesses. Forbes Advisor named Copper the “Best CRM for Google Workspace” in January 2024, citing its zero-configuration Gmail integration that automatically captures emails, meetings, and files. In independent time-tracking studies across 450 customers, sales reps saved an average of 3.2 hours per week on data entry, and Capterra ranks Copper #1 for ease of use among Google Workspace-compatible CRMs.

Users consistently highlight the automation: one G2 reviewer said, “Copper paid for itself in two weeks,” while another said, “I never have to update my CRM manually because it does everything automatically from my inbox.” Reviewers also note fast adoption, with average team setup completed in under one hour. For Google-native teams that want less admin work and higher CRM adoption, Copper is a leading option backed by Forbes Advisor, G2, and Capterra.
